blocked_downstream_by: single-adjustment registry (nfl/production/adjustment_registry.py) does not exist. Not blocking a research-only fit; BLOCKING before any downstream layer consumes OAS1.
calibration_rule: every defined baseline calibration slope is below 1.0 -- pass 0.4432 to 0.7201, rush 0.2323 to 0.6238. The baselines are NOT calibrated in response. The candidate is evaluated against this same unaltered family, and whether OAS1 improves or worsens calibration is determined AFTER the candidate runs, not before.

chain.fold_rule: for a forecast of season S week W, the fitting set is every play with ordinal < S*100 + W, and nothing else
chain.tie_break: among configurations within one standard error of the best mean score, select the most shrunken, in TIE_BREAK_ORDER

cold_start_note: the cold-start stratum is EMPTY (0 plays) in both classes because every club appears in the prior season. An empty stratum is NOT a pass and must not be recorded as one.

construction.centering: within unit family, after fitting, for reporting only
construction.form: prior-season IDENTIFIED strengths plus a governed Week-1 update. NOT a 2026 Week-1 ridge presented as having learned separate offense and defense strengths: that design is rank 32 of 66 with 32 two-node graph components, so 32 dimensions carry no information from the data.
construction.prior_enters_as: weighted pseudo-observations, one per unit, response rho * theta_prev[u], weight kappa
construction.sign_convention: positive offensive strength = better offense; positive defensive strength = WORSE defence
construction.why: 2026 week 1 is rank 32 of 66 with 32 two-node graph components, so 32 dimensions carry no information. The prior-season identified strengths do the identifying; week 1 updates them.

expected_outputs: per-class unit-strength frame: (season, week, team, unit, strength, se, n_plays_current_season, design_rank, design_cols, identified, prior_weight_effective, cfg_*, fit_vintage)
OAS1 vs B5 clustered delta, by game and by team, PRE-REGISTERED, per class
OAS1 vs B4 (pass) clustered delta -- second preregistered hurdle
OAS1 vs B3 (rush) clustered delta, labelled POST_HOC_STRONGEST_BASELINE
calibration slope before and after, against the unaltered baseline family
design rank per chain step, and the claim restricted to identified steps
forbidden: no downstream consumption until the registry exists
grid_frozen: NOT EXPANDED. The 2025 prior-season fit selected lambda at the grid maximum (RIDGE_GRID_BOUNDARY_SELECTED). The grid is NOT widened in response; any expansion is a NEW preregistered experiment.

pass.rule: OAS1 must beat B5 under the pre-registered clustered test AND beat B4, the strongest observed pass baseline, to justify its added complexity. Beating B5 while losing to B4 is a FAILURE under the pre-registered rule.

rush.rule: the pre-registered hurdle remains B5. The comparison against B3 is reported and labelled POST_HOC_STRONGEST_BASELINE. If OAS1 beats B5 but loses to B3, BOTH facts are reported and no promotion conclusion is forced either way.

materiality_rule: STATISTICALLY_DETECTABLE means the clustered interval excludes zero. OPERATIONALLY_MATERIAL is a separate judgement about football size and is NOT implied by it. Six materially different estimators are separated by under one percent MAE in both classes, so an interval excluding zero can accompany a change no downstream consumer would notice. Both are reported; neither is allowed to stand in for the other.
negative_result_action: if OAS1 does not beat B5 out of sample, OAS1 is recorded as a MEASURED NEGATIVE for early-season weeks and B5 is used for the early-season opponent layer. No retuning until OAS1 wins, no strata added, no gate weakened. Re-evaluate around week 6 when the schedule graph has connected.
promotion_criterion: OAS1 is promotable ONLY IF all of: (a) it beats B5 on PRIMARY_SCORE with a game-clustered interval excluding zero; (b) it also beats B4, so the gain is not shrinkage alone; (c) its calibration slope lies in CALIBRATION_SLOPE_BAND; (d) sharpness is improved at MATCHED coverage, not sharpness alone; (e) design rank is recorded at every step and the claim is restricted to steps where the model was identified.

scoring.cluster_rule: when the two disagree materially, report the wider
scoring.primary: out-of-sample play-level MAE on oas1_epa_target against B5, clustered by game, in a forward chain, with the interval excluding zero
